It Reaches Story Explained

A breakdown of the story and characters of It Reaches based on the official Steam description.

Quick Answer

It Reaches follows officer Jason Thompson through a police body camera as he enters an abandoned hospital. What begins as a routine operation escalates into a nightmare, and he must uncover the dark mystery behind the horror that follows him.

Narrative Premise

According to the official Steam description, what should have been a routine police operation quickly escalates into a nightmare for officer Jason Thompson. The body camera perspective makes the player feel like they are watching actual police footage, grounding the horror in a realistic and claustrophobic experience.

Key Characters

Officer Jason Thompson

The playable character. A police officer whose routine operation becomes a nightmare inside the abandoned hospital.

Read Character Guide

The Entity

The relentless force that hunts Jason through the hospital and its underground facilities. Its origin and motives are central to the dark mystery.

Read Character Guide

The Abandoned Hospital

The setting itself is a character: decaying walls, claustrophobic corridors, and underground facilities that hide the truth behind the horror.

Read Setting Guide

The Dark Mystery

The hospital is not just a setting; it is the hiding place for something that has been waiting. The game's marketing emphasizes uncovering a dark mystery left behind and escaping the horrors lurking underground. The full story is delivered through documents, environmental details, and the final confrontation.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is It Reaches based on a true story?

No. It is a fictional horror game by Emberflight Games, though the abandoned hospital setting may draw on familiar horror tropes and urban legends.

What is the entity that hunts you?

The official description calls it something that 'never stops' and 'feels no mercy.' The full game likely reveals more about its origin through documents and environmental storytelling. We will update this section as we collect every piece of lore.
